subject: sounds
title: Same first sound
about: Hear a word and tap the word that starts with the same sound, with no letters shown. This is pure listening (NC RF.1.3.c, isolating the first sound) and mirrors the oral warm-up in every CKLA lesson.
tip: Have him say the first sound of the cue word out loud, then test each choice against it.

cards.note: sun and sock both start with the same sound.
